test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 03 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

To have an itching palm

options.text: To have an urge to slap

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"To have an itching palm"** is best expressed by: **"To be greedy for money"**
 
• The phrase** "to have an itching palm"** is an idiom which means to have a strong desire for money, usually to the point of greed or corruption.
 
• It might also imply wanting to receive a bribe.

Therefore, the** correct answer** is:* 'To be greedy for money'.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Explanation of the other options:
 
 
• **"To have no mercy" -** This phrase in English means to act without kindness or compassion, to be cruel or harsh.(कोई दया नहीं होना)
 
• **"To gain strength" - **This means to become stronger or more powerful. (बल प्राप्त करना)
 
• **"To have an urge to slap" - **This means to have a strong desire to slap someone.(थप्पड़ मारने की तीव्र इच्छा होना)
 
 

1b0:T838,

The correct answer is **'Option 1'.**
